description: Estimate the compulsory annual study or training loan repayment (HELP, HECS, VSL, SFSS, SSL, AASL) for an Australian resident from their repayment income, using the marginal system introduced in 2025-26 with effective-dated thresholds that roll over each financial year. Use it for "how much HELP/HECS will I repay" questions in AU; it does not cover the loan balance, indexation or voluntary repayments, and applies to Australia only. Repayment income is broader than taxable income — it adds back reportable super contributions, reportable fringe benefits, net investment loss and exempt foreign income; pass that combined figure.

repaymentIncome.description: ATO repayment income in AUD (taxable income + reportable super + reportable fringe benefits + net investment loss + exempt foreign income)

taxYear.description: Financial-year label like '2025-26'; omit to use the current Australian financial year

name: student_loan_repayment

country.description: Always AU — this tool is Australia-only

dataVerifiedOn.description: ISO date the rate data was last confirmed against the authority

disclaimer.description: General-information note that must accompany any figure shown to a person

effectiveRate.description: repayment ÷ repayment income, as a fraction

mayBeStale.description: True once the verification date is over a year old — re-confirm with the authority

minThreshold.description: Income at or below which the repayment is nil (AUD)

source.description: The national tax authority the figures were verified against (e.g. 'ATO — ato.gov.au')

sourceUrl.description: https link to the authority page the rate was verified against. Present only on rate answers backed by a verified ledger row — absent (never empty) otherwise, so its presence is itself the claim

taxYear.description: Financial year whose thresholds were used

title: Australian HELP/HECS study-loan repayment
